business_summary: Sakthi Sugars Limited manufactures and sells sugar and its by-products in India. It operates through Sugar, Industrial Alcohol, Power, and Soya Products segments. The company offers white and refined sugar; industrial alcohol, including rectified spirits, extra neutral alcohol/neutral spirits, and ethanol manufactured from molasses; sugar by-products, such as molasses, bagasse, and press muds; bio earth products for use as an organic fertilizer and soil improver; and soya and its by-products. It also operates three cogeneration power plants with an aggregate power generation capacity of 92 megawatts. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Coimbatore, India.
